parallels.note: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

translations.web: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: Any clothing or leather on which there is an emission of semen must be washed with water, and it will remain unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
translations.asv: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
